create_deberta_v2_model: create a DeBERTa-v2 base model for feature extraction and sequence encoding
build_masked_lm_deberta: build a DeBERTa-v2 masked language model for token prediction and fill-mask tasks
classify_sequence_deberta: classify sequences using a DeBERTa-v2 sequence classifier with configurable labels
extract_spans_deberta: extract question answering spans using a DeBERTa-v2 model with start and end logits
tag_tokens_deberta: tag tokens with labels using a DeBERTa-v2 token classifier for NER tasks
